_readme: Engine constants for the PDX Particle Bench. Edit, then press Restart (or Load
.asset) in the panel - no need to reload the add-on.
MEASURED: read off the calibration ruler in game. These are facts about the engine,
not preferences - changing one makes the preview disagree with HoI4. They live here
so they are visible and auditable, not because they are meant to be adjusted.
FITTED: approximations matched by eye against the game, because the behaviour is
chaotic or too subtle to measure. These are the ones worth tuning if your own
reading of the game differs from ours - how each was arrived at is in CHANGELOG.md.
Anything missing or malformed falls back to the built-in value, so a broken file
cannot stop the add-on working - it just prints a warning.
